name: Slack
one_liner: Workplace messaging platform whose developer platform lets teams build apps, agents and integrations.
auth_notes: OAuth v2 authorization code flow (slack.com/oauth/v2/authorize, oauth.v2.access) yields bot (xoxb) and user tokens; xapp app-level token for Socket Mode.
access_notes: Create an app and install to a workspace self-serve; Web API rate tiers are identical across plans. Commercial distribution of apps must go through the Slack Marketplace (review); non-Marketplace commercially distributed apps get conversations.history/replies at 1 req/min, 15 objects. Internal custom apps keep 50+/min, 1000 objects.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve app creation and OAuth, broad Web API plus Events API; but commercial multi-workspace distribution requires Marketplace approval or throttled history/replies limits.

evidence.quote: All Slack plans receive the same rate limit tier for each method.
the Slack Marketplace is the only appropriate channel for commercially distributing apps built with Slack APIs
When you use the Events API, Slack calls you.
Workspace admins can approve and manage all MCP client integrations

disputes.why: App creation/install and same rate tiers on all plans documented; free plan exists (pricing page).
No paid gate for API; Marketplace approval is required for commercial distribution or history/replies drop to 1 req/min.
Large Web API method reference with many families; exact count not verified (page JS-rendered).
Events API and incoming webhooks documented.
Bot and user scopes requested per install per OAuth docs.
